title: Scholar Rock Chief Scientific Officer Conducts Multiple Sales Throughout January 2026
author: Adé Hennis
description: Scholar Rock's Chief Scientific Officer Mo Qatanani sold 14,898 shares on January 22, 2026, for approximately $695,938 as part of a pre-planned Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The sale reduced his direct ownership to 85,660 shares (0.08% of outstanding shares). The company plans to launch its key product candidate apitegromab in U.S. and European markets in 2026, positioning it as a potential treatment for spinal muscular atrophy.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The insider sales are part of a pre-planned trading arrangement and not indicative of loss of confidence. While the company is operating at a net loss, the upcoming launch of apitegromab represents a significant catalyst. The article explicitly states investors should not be alarmed by these transactions, and the stock's modest 4.18% one-year performance reflects the speculative nature of clinical-stage biotech investments.

title: FDA OKs Novartis SMA Treatment As First Gene Therapy Option For Kids, Teens And Adults
author: Vandana Singh
description: The FDA approved Novartis' Itvisma, a gene replacement therapy for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), which can treat patients two years and older by addressing the genetic root cause of the disease with a one-time fixed dose.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Received FDA approval for innovative gene therapy treatment, first of its kind for broad SMA patient population
Received a Complete Response Letter from FDA for their SMA treatment application

title: Why Scholar Rock Stock Raced 6% Higher Today
author: Eric Volkman
